spec.description: Very distant broad aqueduct landscape silhouette for a pixel art RPG background. Full single panorama INSIDE canvas with at least 8px empty transparent border on ALL FOUR edges, especially ABOVE tallest tower. Low topdown side panorama. One connected continuous geological shelf below piers, NO floating separate pillars. Important: exactly one isolated whole panorama and generous transparent margins.
